cells.E:
Variation

Depending upon the size that your product is available in please select the relevant size and fill in the necessary information. Example: Clothing comes in XS, S, M,L,XL,XXL etc according to body type Footwear comes in 37, 38, 39 according to foot size Beddings come in king, queen or single according to bed size, etc. If the relevant size for your product is not available in the drop down, please select Free Size.
cells.F:
Meesho Price

This is the normal/regular price at which you sell on Meesho. This price shall be lower than the Maximum Retail Price (MRP) of the Product. Customers buying at this price will be able to return products for all reasons. 

Customers buying at this price will be able to return products for all reasons.
cells.G:
Wrong/Defective Returns Price

Enter the price at which you want to sell this product on Meesho app

Customers buying at this price can only return wrong/defective delivered items. Check all applicable return reasons in 'Return Reasons' sheet

Recommend entering Rs.28 lower than Meesho Price, based on reverse shipping & handling cost savings
cells.H:
MRP

“MRP” stands for “Maximum Retail Price”. It's the highest price that a seller is allowed to sell a product for including taxes, charges added on the basic price of the product. No seller can sell a product for a price higher than MRP. Acceptable in INR ONLY. This information is generally available on the packaging label for pre-packed products. If you are not listing a pre-packed product, please provide the MRP as per the explanation above.
cells.J:
HSN ID

Select the HSN ID from the dropdown.
cells.K:
Net Weight (gms)

Means the total weight of the product excluding the packaging weight, in grams (g). This information is available on the packaging label for pre-packed products. If you are not listing a pre-packed product, please check the weight of the product excluding any external packing and provide such information in SI Unit - grams.
cells.L:
Inventory

Number of items you have in stock.
cells.M:
Country of Origin

Country of Origin means the country in which the product has been produced/assembled. This information is available on the packaging label for pre- packed products. If you are not listing a pre-packed product, please provide the country in which the product is manufactured.
cells.N:
Manufacturer Name

Enter the name of the Manufacturer which means the entity which has produced the product. This information is available on the packaging label of the product. Find “manufactured by” on the label. Manufacturer name may look like: ABC Appliances Pvt. Ltd.  If this information is not available on the label of your product or your product does not have a label, provide the details of the entity/person who is responsible for producing your product.
cells.O:
Manufacturer Address

Enter the complete address of the Manufacturer which means the entity which has produced the product. This information is generally available on the packaging label of the product. Find “manufactured by” on the label. In the address, please specify the street, village/ town/ district along with the name of the state. If this information is not available on the label of your product or your product does not have a label, provide the details of the entity/person who is responsible for producing your product.
cells.P:
Manufacturer Pincode

Enter the pincode mentioned in the manufacturers’ address.
cells.Q:
Packer Name

Enter the name of the Packer which generally means the entity which has packed the product. Packer details can generally be found on the label of the product. Find “Packed by” or “Pkd” on the label. Manufacturer name may look like: ABC Appliances Pvt. Ltd. In case your product does not have this information, provide the details of the packer of your product. In many cases, the manufacturer and packer may be the same.
cells.R:
Packer Address

Enter the address of the Packer which generally means the entity which has packed the product. Packer details can generally be found on the label of the product. Find “Packed by” or “Pkd” on the label. In case your product does not have this information, provide the details of the packer of your product. In many cases, the manufacturer and packer may be the same.
cells.S:
Packer Pincode

Enter the pincode mentioned in the packers’ address.
cells.T:
Importer Name

Enter the name of the Importer which means the entity which has imported the product from any other country into India for sale in India. This information is generally available on the packaging label of the product. Find “imported by” on the label. If this information is not available on the label of your product or your product does not have a label, provide the details of the entity/person who is responsible for importing your product.
cells.U:
Importer Address

Enter the address of the Importer which means the entity which has imported the product from any other country into India for sale in India. This information is generally available on the packaging label of the product. Find “imported by” on the label. If this information is not available on the label of your product or your product does not have a label, provide the details of the entity/person who is responsible for importing your product.
cells.V:
Importer Pincode

Enter the pincode mentioned in the importers’ address.
cells.Z:
Generic Name

Generic Name means the commonly used name through which a product is generally called/known. Generic name DOES NOT MEAN the name of the brand or manufacturer of the product or its use.
cells.AA:
Net Quantity (N)

Net Quantity means total number of units in the product. If the product is a multi- pack, please mention the total number of units in the multi-pack. 

For example- if you are selling t-shirts in a multi-pack of 4, please specify 4.

cells.AH: Brand refers to a type of product manufactured by a company under a particular name.
cells.AI: Occasion refers to the type of event that the product is ideally suited for. This is a Multi-Text attribute, that is, multiple options can be chosen. Please avoid combinations like Casual::Formal, Formal::Sports, Sports::Ethnic, Sports::Wedding, as these will not make any sense for the customer.
cells.AJ: Fabric refers to the materials used to make a particular product.
cells.AK: Pattern refers to a repeated decorative sketch that is printed or engraved on a product.
cells.AL: Type refers to the style and appearance of the product based on the region/culture of its origin.
cells.AM: Sari Purity refers to purity of the fabric used in making the sari.
cells.AN: Ideal For refers to which gender the product would be most suitable for.
cells.AO: Pack of refers to the total number of main products that are included by the brand in the package. For eg - If the package contains of 3 sarie`s. Kindly fill the data as 3.
cells.AP: Length refers to the measurement from top to base of sari. This would be only sari length excluding blouse piece.
cells.AQ: Blouse Piece Length refers to the measurement of the blouse piece from top to base of the blouse piece.If blouse piece not included in package then value should be filled 0.
cells.AR: Sari Style refers to the classification of the sari based on the manner it which it can be draped.
cells.AS: Size refers to the size of the product as mentioned by the brand.
cells.AT: Size- Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the size of the product. If you are filling the size as "Free", then the qualifier will be "Regular". If size is selected as age group 4-5 Years or 2-5 Years etc, then the qualifier will be "Kids"
cells.AU: Style Code is the alphanumeric code which is uniform across size variants of a product, and is used to group different sizes of the same product in website product page. Please do not fill MRP, promotional content information under style code.
cells.AV: Color refers to the shade of the product as specified by the brand on the label or sales package. The value 'Multicolor' should be used if the product features a mix of three or more prominent colors. Possible values include 'Red,' 'Black,' etc
cells.AW: Brand Color refers to the shade of the product. Sometimes it can be a name derived from only alphabets  or it can be alphanumeric as well. The value 'Multicolor' should be used if the product has 3 or more prominent colors on the product. Possible values are Peppy Red  Berry Red  etc.
cells.AX: Blouse Piece Type refers to the types of blouse piece comes with a sari. If blouse piece is not included in package select No Blouse.
cells.AY: Image Details - Front View - A full front view of a sari is a photo of the sari from the front, with the model standing straight. It shows the fit, design details, and style. | Minimum Resolution - 200x800 | Please see the Image Guidelines sheet for more details.
cells.AZ: Image Details - Back View - A back view of a sari is a photo showing the sari from behind, focusing on how it looks from the back. This view shows the pallu, design details, and how the sari is draped and fits. | Minimum Resolution - 200x800 | Please see the Image Guidelines sheet for more details.
cells.BA: Image Details - Side view - A side view of a sari is a photo showing the sari from the side, highlighting features like the side profile, seams, and other details. | Minimum Resolution - 200x800 | Please see the Image Guidelines sheet for more details.
cells.BB: Image Details - Blouse View - A blouse view for a sari is a photo that focuses on the blouse worn with the sari. It shows the blouse design, fit, fabric, and any decorations. | Minimum Resolution - 200x800 | Please see the Image Guidelines sheet for more details.
cells.BC: Image Details - Zoomed View - A zoomed bottom view image of a sari is a close-up photo that focuses on specific details, like the material, stitching, or small design features. | Minimum Resolution - 200x800 | Please see the Image Guidelines sheet for more details.
cells.BD: Image Details - Dark tone Background view - A dark tone background view for a sari is a photo where the sari is shown with a dark-colored background. This helps the colors, details, and patterns of the sari stand out more, making it look more vibrant and elegant. | Minimum Resolution - 200x800 | Please see the Image Guidelines sheet for more details.
cells.BE: Minimum Resolution - 200x800 | Please see the Image Guidelines sheet for more details.
cells.BF: Minimum Resolution - 200x800 | Please see the Image Guidelines sheet for more details.
cells.BG: Please see the image URL guidelines in the summary sheet.
cells.BH: Pattern/Print Type refers to the types of the repeated decorative sketch that is printed or engraved on a product.
cells.BI: Border details refers to the ornamental design along the edge of an garment
cells.BJ: Decorative Material refers to the type of work created on the product for its design and patterns.
cells.BK: Blouse Fabric refers to the material used to make a particular blouse.
cells.BL: Type of Embroidery refers to the type of unique designs created on the product.
cells.BM: Fabric Care refers to the directions to be followed with respect to taking care of the product. It would relate to the washing and drying instructions for customers.
cells.BN: Video uploads aren't yet supported on Seller Hub. Please contact Seller Support to add videos to your product listings.
cells.BO: Domestic Warranty refers to the number of years that the brand supports the domestic warranty of the product.
cells.BP: Domestic Warranty - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the domestic warranty. Units should be filled only in singular form.
cells.BQ: Uniform refers to whether the sari color/design can be used for uniform purpose or not.
cells.BR: Transparent refers to whether the saree fabric is sheer or see-through in nature.
cells.BS: Construction Type refers to the technology used to manufacture the product.
cells.BT: Border Length refers to the width of saree border.
cells.BU: Blouse Pattern refers to a repeated decorative sketch that is printed or engraved on a blouse.
cells.BV: Embroidery Method refers to whether the embroidery on the product has been designed by hand or machine.
cells.BW: EAN is a 13 digit bar code. In case you have UPC, prefix 0 to make it 13 digits. EAN/UPC is limited to 13 characters (including spaces). If not applicable, Please leave it blank.
cells.BX: EAN/UPC - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the external identifier. Units should be filled only in singular form. Possible values are EAN, UPC, etc.
cells.BY: Weight refers to the weight of the product only, without packaging. Please ensure that the values entered are in Kilograms. Possible values are 1, 1.5, etc.
cells.BZ: Other Details refers to any additional information on the features of the product that would be useful to a customer.
cells.CA: Please write few lines describing your product along with a list of products that are compatible with this product. Description is limited to 10000 characters (including spaces). It should not include any hyperlinks, additional offers, or promotion text.
cells.CB: Search Keywords refers to the words which the customer might use to find a product. These keywords are tagged to the product and when the buyer searches with the appropriate search word(s), the nearest appropriate product is retrieved and displayed on Flipkart website. The search output is also based on multiple other factors such as Product Quality, Pricing, etc. Please enter a maximum of 5 keywords for this purpose.
cells.CC: Supplier Image refers to the name of the image that you will upload.
